title: cotoneaster parvifolius
intro: Cotoneaster parvifolius, commonly known as the small-leaf cotoneaster, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a shrub native to the mountainous regions of Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster parvifolius include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and promoting wound healing, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Additionally, the plant's antioxidant properties are attributed to its rich content of vitamins C and E, as well as its high levels of polyphenolic compounds.
